output.technical_predicate: Ordinary case route (/case/{id}) and offer download route (/case/{id}/offer) must be reachable only by the authenticated owner or the assigned officer; any other borrower or unassigned officer must be denied.
applicability_facts: Scenario: synthetic EU-established private controller; risk is disclosure of a synthetic case or offer via its ordinary case and download routes.
Permitted principals are stipulated as the owner and the assigned officer.
app.py:0092-0095 routes /case/{id} and /case/{id}/offer through store.get_case(db, who, cid).
store.py:0055-0058 get_case selects the case only WHERE id=? AND (owner=? OR officer=?), raising 404 otherwise.
app.py:0110-0112 serves the ordinary case view (op is None) after get_case, with no further principal check.
app.py:0100-0103 serves the offer download after get_case; the only added condition is stage in (accepted, offered) and not restricted.
store.py:0111-0112 offer() returns case id, email, amount and term for the case object already gated by get_case.
relevant_exceptions: No exception in the supplied source permits a non-owner, non-assigned-officer principal to reach these routes.
The offer route's stage/restriction gate (app.py:0102) is an availability condition, not an access exception.
The owner-only check at app.py:0105 applies to access/portable, not to the ordinary case or offer routes.
required_controls: Single authorization gate on case lookup: store.get_case (store.py:0055-0058) restricts to owner or assigned officer and returns 404 for others.
Ordinary case route (app.py:0110-0112) must be served only after that gate; no bypass path exists in the supplied routing.
Offer download route (app.py:0100-0103) must be served only after that gate, with offer payload (store.py:0111-0112) derived from the gated case row.
Authentication prerequisite: unauthenticated requests are rejected at app.py:0068-0070 before any case route is reached.
Dashboard listing (app.py:0077) also filters by owner or officer, consistent with the same principal set.
assessment_limits: Assessment is static reading of supplied source only; no execution, browsing or oracle was used.
store.py, views.py and style.css are supplied artifacts; behavior of any code not shown cannot be assessed.
Session store is in-memory (app.py:0024, 0046-0047); session fixation/expiry behavior beyond the shown 8-hour expiry is not evaluated.
The offer route's stage/restriction condition is noted but not assessed for correctness against other obligations.
No conclusion is drawn about upstream or hidden implementations; only the supplied snapshot establishes the controls.
